hooks.command: i=$(cat); printf '%s' "$i" | grep -qE '"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*(rm[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*[rR]|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+--force|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|DROP[[:space:]]+TABLE)' && { echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

i=$(cat); c=$(printf '%s' "$i" | sed -n 's/.*"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); echo "$(date '+%F %T') | $c" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/audit.log" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
